consequence.statement: The etcd.operator kvstore-opt configuration value will be ignored and no longer has any effect; environments must rely on the new automatic behavior of respecting the port specified in etcd configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove the etcd.operator kvstore-opt setting from Helm values as it is now a no-op. Verify that etcd addresses include the correct port if non-standard ports are used, as Cilium will now respect the specified port rather than defaulting to the service port.

original.statement: The etcd.operator kvstore-opt Helm value option is now a no-op and has been removed; Cilium now respects the port in the etcd configuration and automatically enables Kubernetes service DNS name to ClusterIP translation for etcd.

consequence.statement: Setting etcd.operator in kvstore-opt no longer has any effect, but service DNS name to ClusterIP translation for etcd is now enabled automatically when needed. Cilium now connects using the port given in the etcd configuration instead of defaulting to the service's port when the address matches a Kubernetes service DNS name.
consequence.remediation: Optionally drop the etcd.operator kvstore-opt entry because it is now a no-op. Check that the ports in your etcd configuration are the ones Cilium should connect to, since they are now used as written instead of the service port.
